findings.evidence: 4d. Over the limit and the essential content cannot fit: ask whether to make a thread; on yes, or if you cannot ask, VERSION 1-3 become three alternative threads ... If the user asks to expand only one post into a thread ... that one thread goes in THREAD. Never return an over-limit standalone post. For a longer allowance, ask for the ceiling; if you cannot ask, keep 280.
findings.fix: The Process pattern fits, but steps 1, 2 and 4d pack several branches into one paragraph each. Split 4d into labelled sub-bullets without removing any rule: (i) ask about a thread, (ii) three alternative threads when the user says yes or you cannot ask, (iii) expand one post only, which goes in THREAD, (iv) longer allowance. Apply the same split to steps 1 and 2.

findings.evidence: It is an estimate, not twitter-text: emoji sequences and Unicode normalisation can differ.
